replacements.label: shared candidate encoding
replacements.reference:
def candidate_vectors_with_shared_pool(
    model: base.SequentialTwoTower,
    positives: torch.Tensor,
    negatives: torch.Tensor,
    pool_size: int,
    generator: torch.Generator,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """Encode each item once and expose current positives as a negative pool."""
    all_items = torch.cat([positives, negatives.reshape(-1)])
    unique_items, inverse = torch.unique(all_items, return_inverse=True)
    encoded = model.encode_items(unique_items)
    positive_vectors = encoded[inverse[: len(positives)]]
    negative_vectors = encoded[inverse[len(positives) :]].reshape(
        len(positives), negatives.shape[1], -1
    )
    pool_items = torch.unique(positives)
    pool_vectors = encoded[torch.searchsorted(unique_items, pool_items)]
    if pool_size and len(pool_items) > pool_size:
        selected = torch.randperm(
            len(pool_items), generator=generator, device="cpu"
        )[:pool_size].to(pool_items.device)
        pool_items = pool_items[selected]
        pool_vectors = pool_vectors[selected]
    return positive_vectors, negative_vectors, pool_items, pool_vectors

replacements.label: shared false-negative filtering
replacements.reference:
def valid_shared_negatives(
    shared_items: torch.Tensor,
    positive_items: torch.Tensor,
    user_rows: np.ndarray,
    state_ids: np.ndarray,
    prepared: SequenceData,
    known_positive_packed: np.ndarray | None,
    device: torch.device,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Return current-block items that are valid negatives for each query."""
    shared = shared_items.detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.int64, copy=False)
    positives = positive_items.detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.int64, copy=False)
    invalid = positives[:, None] == shared[None, :]
    if known_positive_packed is not None:
        byte_columns = shared >> 3
        bit_values = np.left_shift(
            np.uint8(1), (shared & 7).astype(np.uint8, copy=False)
        )
        invalid |= (
            known_positive_packed[user_rows[:, None], byte_columns[None, :]]
            & bit_values[None, :]
        ) != 0
    liked = prepared.liked_states[state_ids].astype(np.int64, copy=False)
    for column in range(liked.shape[1]):
        invalid |= liked[:, column, None] == shared[None, :]
    return torch.from_numpy(~invalid).to(device)

replacements.label: shared negative loss
replacements.reference:
if shared_pool:
            if user_rows is None or item_correction is None:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "shared negatives require user rows and item corrections"
                )
            valid = valid_shared_negatives(
                shared_items,
                positive_items[begin:end],
                user_rows[begin:end],
                selected_states,
                prepared,
                known_positive_packed,
                device,
            )
            shared_logits = query_vectors @ shared_vectors.T
            shared_weights = valid.to(shared_logits.dtype) * item_correction[
                shared_items.detach().cpu()
            ].to(device)[None, :]
            shared_loss = (
                F.softplus(shared_logits) * shared_weights
            ).sum(dim=1) / shared_weights.sum(dim=1).clamp_min(1.0e-6)
            uniform_loss = F.softplus(
                negative_logits[:, : config.uniform_negatives]
            ).mean(dim=1)
            total = config.uniform_negatives + config.inbatch_negatives
            negative_loss = (
                config.uniform_negatives * uniform_loss
                + config.inbatch_negatives * shared_loss
            ) / total
            statistics["shared_pair_correct"] += float(
                (
                    (positive_logits.detach()[:, None] > shared_logits.detach())
                    & valid
                )
                .sum()
                .cpu()
            )
            statistics["shared_comparisons"] += float(valid.sum().cpu())
